title: Repeated sampling as a list search
statement: Let $N,L,k$ be natural numbers and let $r$ be a finite list of bits. The result of sampling at most $k$ successive length-$L$ blocks of $r$, interpreting each block as a binary number with its first bit least significant, is the first value less than $N$ in the resulting list, or no value if there is none.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is a finite list of bits
